provenance: Independent additions from ZooKeeper3.9.3 zookeeper.jute, MultiOperationRecord and PrepRequestProcessor. No subject output, live tree or production schema supplies an expectation.

root_watch_case.rule: Serialize the snapshot root as empty path. Accept slash as the legal operation/watch path, normalize it only for node lookup, and retain slash for its5-byte Jute wire string. Empty operation/watch paths reject.

format_rejections.change: serialized snapshot tree contains both empty root and slash root

format_rejections.scope: Standalone SetACL remains supported. This finite multi subset follows real mutation requests; persisted Error children have their explicit history arm.

format_rejections.reason: Jute signed-int32 buffer length cannot encode this bound.
The data buffer fits int32, but32-byte TxnHeader plus operation body is2147483648; the enclosing transaction buffer length overflows.

history_rule: ErrorTxn is a persisted4-byte body for failed write operations; aborted MultiTxn records may carry Error children. Their counts belong in the finite complete history. Supporting these codecs does not prove actual error/rate/history counts or a production znode schema.
